content:
The execution failed due to schema mismatches and formatting errors in the generated output JSON and summary text.
The test_schema_and_assumptions failed because the 'assumptions' key contained nested models (e.g., '14_day_model') instead of the expected flat keys like 'deliveries_per_year_14_day'. In test_rows_and_order, therapy objects used 'financials_7_day' groupings instead of the required flat keys like 'annual_margin_14_day_usd'. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text lacked comma-formatted currency strings (e.g., '-455,619.31'), providing raw floats instead.
